data.text: Luke, I care deeply about keeping our village clinic open, but before we commit everyone’s income, can you share confirmation of the $60,000 shortfall and today’s deadline? Could we catch 10 tons each, keeping the lake at full capacity, and find the remaining $10,000 through donations or a payment arrangement with the clinic? If that truly won’t restore essential treatment in time, I’m open to the one-time 15-ton contribution—but we’d need everyone’s agreement to your zero catch this month and a total cap of 30 tons next month. John, what do you think?
